areas.title: Core product promise and epistemic boundaries
areas.review_focus: Review the five epistemic layers, absolute integrity invariants, and the rule that lower layers cannot rewrite higher layers.
areas.review_summary: Source review and owner discussion completed in this conversation on 2026-10-09. Product Constitution v1.6.1 establishes CE's identity and absolute integrity invariants; Calculation Constitution v1.9 defines the numerical/geometric source-of-record boundary and prohibits invented/synthetic/stale state; Signal Engine v1.4 and Interpretive Canon v1.2 preserve downstream qualification/interpretive boundaries; Evidence, AI & Output Validation v1.4 limits AI to authorized language infrastructure and fail-closed claim validation. Preserve the core invariant: CE must never make the user believe CE knows more than CE actually knows. Normative and governance sources jointly constrain CE; working artifacts, convenience, commercial goals, or autonomous operation cannot override them.

areas.title: Look Back, Look Today, Tomorrow Check, Look Future and Quiet Sky
areas.review_focus: Review product time model and distinguish a valid no-signal observation from technical failure.
areas.review_summary: Source-level semantic review completed against the characterized V1 stack. Look Back is experience-first, controlled-category, session-only and not truth proof; Look Today may show only qualified Testable Sky Signal; Tomorrow Check receives the user's categorical report and compares it with yesterday's testable signal without forcing mismatch to match; Look Future is grounded in upcoming calculations, Canon, and only explicitly permitted current-session input, and remains possibility not guarantee. Quiet Sky is the aggregate result of a valid completed observation with zero qualifying signals. Any non-VALID technical state remains a separate failure/unavailable state: no signal, Canon claim, Quiet Sky promotion, or stale substitution. This is semantic/source reconciliation only, not runtime conformance or test execution; exact byte lineage of the characterized copies to the representative governing archive remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.

areas.title: Product voice, tone and consumer experience

areas.title: Canon Rule Registry and allowed semantic coverage

areas.review_summary: The characterized Interpretive Canon v1.2 requires a provenance-bound, versioned Rule Registry as the source of semantic permission; absent/mismatching rules must produce no interpretation. In exact A9 candidate c8dab354…, src/ce/canon/registry.py provides schema-aware CanonRule/CanonRegistry parsing but module-level get_rule() deliberately raises CanonRegistryNotEstablished because the registry is not materialized; the inspected PR#26 tree has code/schema but no populated Canon data file. Similar-named test_registry_100/H2 artifacts are calculation-core test/coverage registers, and tests/test_registry_r1.py validates calculation object/aspect/orb registries, not interpretive rules. Historical CE_RULEBOOK_v1.0 is in the historical V8 intake and cannot be promoted by name/location. Bounded Box, Library, Dropbox and exact candidate-path searches did not identify a separately approved/populated current V1 Canon-rule registry or its authority/promotion record. This remains NOT_ESTABLISHED in the inspected scope, not universal non-existence. Recommendation: preserve fail-closed behavior; do not invent/promote Canon rules; prepare a source-backed, independently reviewed candidate rule set with provenance/conflict analysis and version/digest-bound claim-manifest tests before asking for a consolidated semantic disposition.

areas.title: Voice Boundary and negative-sounding language
areas.review_focus: Find approved V1 voice disposition; distinguish honest limitations from unnecessary fear, fatalism, or demeaning language.
areas.review_summary: Owner disposition Box 2515505499720 expressly accepts the high-level direction that truth, evidence, Canon/claim authorization and accurate system state are hard constraints; flexible style should be clear, warm, considerate and non-fatalistic where truthful; no blanket ban on every negative-sounding word or forced positivity; the historical Voice Constitution is not silently promoted to V1 authority. Owner clarification Box 2515492744135 confirms a strict/formal Voice Boundary was not adopted for V1 and warns that rigid rules could undermine honesty. Voice Proposal Source Reconciliation R1 Box 2515526817086 classifies evidence/claim/certainty/failure/mismatch/hidden-knowledge controls as directly grounded in V1, while tone and lexical rules remain proposed style guidance. Recommendation: retain two layers—blocking structural/semantic integrity gates and non-blocking editorial style guidance; style becomes blocking only where the actual content causes a substantive truth, certainty, fear/fatalism, safety, privacy or commercial-integrity violation. No normative amendment or code gate is authorized; detailed combined Today’s Note + voice contract remains to be presented for a focused decision after review is consolidated.

areas.title: Feedback, mismatch, and anti-confirmation safeguards
areas.review_focus: Preserve session-scoped categorical feedback, no narrative rescue, and no feedback-to-accuracy conversion.
